meta.title: How access is separated
meta.description: Understand who sees what before you share something personal.

hero.title: How access is separated
hero.lead: Understand who sees what before you share something personal.

steps.title: When you book
steps.body: You choose a professional and a time. Your employer sees nothing about your booking.

steps.title: What your employer sees
steps.body: HR sees anonymised usage for groups of 10 or more. They never see who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

steps.title: What we keep and for how long
steps.body: Session notes stay with the professional. We keep booking records as long as the law requires.
